summary: Frontend-only regression for two new PMS Connect Hub features: Pilot Takip Listesi (mini-CRM) and Kill Switch Tatbikatı. Logged in as admin, navigated via command palette to PMS Bağlantı Merkezi, exercised full lead CRUD (add → status davet→görüşme→demo → note edit → close/reopen persistence), ran kill-switch drill (BAŞARILI ✓, 4-step report, copy + PDF buttons), fetched PDF via authenticated page.request → HTTP 200 application/pdf 2816 bytes with %PDF magic bytes. Regression checks: Pilot Davet still generates invite section; Trust Center kill-switch button is in default/inactive outlined style after drill (drill self-deactivates in step 4). All acceptance criteria met.
critical_code_review_comments: PmsConnectHub.js is 832 lines — consider splitting leads and drill sections into dedicated subcomponents for maintainability.
saveLeadNote is triggered onBlur only when value changed vs (l.note || '') — this correctly avoids empty-diff writes; good pattern.
seed_data_creation: Created one additional pilot lead 'TEST_Otel_1786832715' (status=demo, note='Demo 20 Ağustos planlandı') alongside pre-existing 'Test Otel Marmaris'. Both prefixed TEST_ compatible; may be cleaned up if needed.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Nav path: after admin login, PMS Bağlantı Merkezi lives under Channels & Distribution nav-section but its testid button isn't rendered until section is expanded. Reliable navigation is via [data-testid='command-palette-trigger'] → type 'PMS Bağlantı' → Enter. All hub action buttons live in the header action row: pms-invite-btn, pms-leads-btn, pms-drill-btn, plus existing PDF/forecast/weekly buttons. PDF endpoints require session cookies — use page.request.get (not urllib) to preserve httpOnly cookies.
